replay.scenario_counting_note: Scenario count here is the number of declared checkpoint case scripts; each script is treated as one input/composed-input scenario. Internal BOP operations/assertions within one script are not separate scenarios.

limitations: Replays use already-built pinned B/F binaries; no CMake or compiler build was invoked.
This does not run a fresh Agent patch/apply/build end to end or validate a second machine.
